meta.what: Documented events used to link peaks. Dates and descriptions come from the event ledger in knowledge/KNOWLEDGE_STADT_HEILBRONN.md (built from the dataset) and from heilbronn.de (27 Jul 2026, fetched 14 Nov 2026).
meta.source_rule: source_url is filled by the events stage from the matching post in the dataset (evidence_title_regex). If no post matches, source_url stays null and the event is shown as 'document not linked'. We never type a URL by hand unless we opened it.
meta.after_dataset: Events after 27 Oct 2026 are marked after_dataset=true and can only be shown in the live strip.
